intent: Keep main data/action visible and use one accessible disclosure primitive

outputs.contract: bounded leaf or explicit refusal, not canonical completion

acceptance: Reviewed SCR matrix plus actual keyboard/text-scale acceptance; no hidden authority/failure.
guards: Source HEAD or dependency receipt digest changed: rebase and semantic review before dispatch.
Exact file owner or required scope/grant unavailable: stop, send evidence + affected current tasks to lead; no speculative store or authority.
Native/user proof unavailable: record NOT_RUN/blocked; pure green cannot consume higher-tier edge.
Stop before implementation until a bounded leaf and upstream acceptance/authority are approved; a planning dependency is not a completion receipt.
Reconcile a current bounded owner packet before dispatch; new source hashes do not renew historical acceptance
resume: Read this complete packet, current canonical source row, source-head/digest and dependency receipts; run named negative path first.
